why: The black dot moves to the next corner clockwise each step: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left. Next it comes back to the top-left corner, which is option 2. Option 3 stays at the bottom-left and option 4 goes back to the bottom-right.
trick: For a moving dot, say the corners in order (TL, TR, BR, BL) and continue the cycle.
